# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.14

*Version code 72*

## What's New

**One clear choice when something ends**
Up Next and recommendations now share one compact card instead of appearing as separate prompts.
For a series, the next episode takes priority and can begin automatically after a short countdown.
When there is no next episode, StreamDek shows a recommendation instead. You can play it
immediately, add it to your Watchlist without leaving the player, or dismiss the card and let the
credits continue.

Your existing recommendation settings still decide whether suggestions appear, how early the card
arrives and whether one or two recommendations are shown.

**Restart an episode or movie from the beginning**
Episodes now offer **Restart Episode** when they have been watched either partly or completely.
Long-press a watched episode on its series page to find the action, or use it directly from that
episode's sources page. Watched and partly watched movies offer the matching **Restart Movie**
action on their sources page.

Restart begins playback at zero without removing the title from your watched history. The option
stays hidden for anything you have not started, so ordinary episode menus and source pages remain
uncluttered.

## Improvements

**A cleaner end-of-playback card**
The Up Next card is smaller and more balanced, with artwork, title and actions kept together rather
than stretching a recommendation across the screen. **Play Now** remains the primary action, while
Watchlist status is visible alongside it.

**Setup links go exactly where they promise**
StreamDek setup links can now open registration, sign-in, profile creation, Content Services,
Add-ons, Sync Services, Player, Streams or connected-device settings directly. Links are restricted
to known setup destinations, and opening one preserves the normal Back journey through the app.

## Fixed

* Fixed the next-episode prompt and recommendations competing for the same moment near the end of
  playback.
* Fixed recommendation playback stopping at a title page instead of continuing into the selected
  movie when a playable source was already available.
* Fixed the recommendation card's final item expanding to fill unused width.
* Fixed completed titles losing a useful restart path once their resume position had been cleared.
